what: How tall a photo on the guest form may stand, for every shape the value can arrive in. One table, two readers: imgHeightVh in prearrival.html draws the guest's photo from it, giHeightVal in staff.html seeds the Settings slider from it. Neither file can import the other - a guest page loads no staff code - so this is the CLAUDE.md rule 3 table both copies answer to, the phone_cases.json pattern.
means: stored is what /prearrivalinfo holds; vh is the percent of screen height the photo may fill; null vh is `natural`, which is not a height at all but the whole photo, uncropped, with no cap.
why: The four named steps became a slider on 11 Sep: they could not be adjusted and the smallest still stood at 28% of the screen. The names stay readable for good, because every record written before the slider holds one.

cases.note: the old named steps keep their heights for ever
not a height: the whole photo, uncropped
the slider's rest, which is what banner always was
rounded: a max-height is whole percents
below the floor clamps up rather than vanishing the photo
above the ceiling clamps down: no photo owns the screen
a number that arrived as text still reads as the number
nothing chosen wears the banner default
a word nobody offers falls back rather than breaking
